channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Capcom is reviving more dormant franchises after the success of Onimusha: Way of the Sword
item.description: After Onimusha: Way of the Sword sold more than a million copies at launch, Capcom is now looking to revive some of its other forgotten IPs.

item.title: Opaque recurrence, and other AI terms that you should probably know
item.description: The rise of AI has brought an avalanche of new terms and slang. Here is a glossary with definitions of some of the most important words and phrases you might encounter.

item.title: An electric plane that transforms into a boat just flew its first human-crewed flight — Viceroy Seaglider has a 15,000lbs MTOW and will fly up to 180 miles
item.description: REGENT’s Viceroy has completed its first crewed flight, advancing an electric seaglider programme aimed at coastal travel and defence operations.

item.title: Scientists develop ‘ultrafast magnetic-field pulses’ memory system that could cut AI data center energy use by 100x — and even get close to hitting thermodynamic limits
item.description: A new scientific paper outlines a way to cut AI data center energy usage by ‘orders of magnitude’.

item.title: Dodge component price hikes with the iBuyPower Labor Day sale — save up to $350 on gaming PCs featuring an AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, RX 9070XT, and 32GB of DDR5 RAM
item.description: The iBuyPower Labor Day sale has big discounts of up to $350 on gaming PCs featuring top-end components such as the Ryzen 7 7800X3D, RX 9070XT, RTX 5080, and 32GB of DDR5 RAM.

item.title: What's the difference between Sony WF-1000XM6 and WF-1000XM5 earbuds?
item.description: Everything you need to know to decide which set of Sony earbuds are right for you.

item.title: The A2 e-tron is Audi's most efficient EV to date
item.description: While it probably won't be available in the US, the Audi A2 e-tron looks like an appealing affordable EV with plenty of range.

item.title: Another Rowhammer attack has been detected, and Nvidia workstation GPUs are firmly in the firing line
item.description: Nvidia spent a year telling people ECC was the answer to GPU Rowhammer. GPUThor might have just proved them wrong.

item.title: A secret new Elizabeth Holmes documentary stuns Telluride
item.description: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's secret Elizabeth Holmes documentary, "You Can See Everything," stunned Telluride audiences Sunday night with its generous access to the Theranos founder.

item.title: How to make your iPhone's alarm ring at full volume even when your calls are muted
item.description: Apple's sound settings often meant you'd sleep through your iPhone alarm if you lowered the volume before you went to bed. With its new update, that is no more.

item.title: Two major security flaws are affecting more than six million WordPress websites
item.description: Patches are available, so WordPress users should hurry up and apply them.
